column3: The School Trip Next Week
Uuu... Kyou-chan is a meanie at times.
This is bad... Was I a little too blunt?
It'd probably be better if I said something here.
Say, Manami...
But I don't really dislike a meanie Kyou-chan.
No matter how mean, Kyou-chan's Kyou-chan.
Don't say such embarrassing things...
Ehehe～～
Sorry, sorry. Since it is you, I thought of teasing you a little.
If it's me?
Yes! Limited to you.
Geez... Kyou-chan...
But it's all right. No matter how you act, Kyou-chan will always be Kyou-chan.
Pff, what's that?
By the way, Kyou-chan.
Hm?
I'm really looking forward to the "school trip" next week.
School... trip?
Oh? Kyou-chan, could it be...
Did you forget all about the school trip?
Come to think of it...
Because of the Siscaly tournament incident, I completely forgot about it. I'm actually going to Kyoto for a school trip...
Aahh... You forgot...
Could this girl actually read my mind?
I just remembered about it.
It'll be fun!
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
I want to go to the "Waterfall of Kiyomizu-dera" when we get to Kyoto.
It sure is a girly choice...
Do you have someone you want to marry?
K-Kyou-chan?! What are you saying?!
N-Nothing... It's fine if you don't want to talk about it.
So I can't talk about such a topic? Manami is also a girl after all.
T-There's also the "Kitano Tenman-gu shrine"! With the god of knowledge!
Ah, I'm interested in that too.
If it's the god of knowledge, I can pray for a higher grade.
Kyou-chan is an exam candidate after all.
'After all' is unnecessary.
Kyou-chan, is there any place you're interested in?
Hmm...
I've clearly forgotten about this school trip, I can't really reply with that.
Well, if I were to give an answer...
Marriage waterfall? What's that?
It's a waterfall called Otowa, it's said that you'll meet your destined one just by drinking its water!
I don't imagine someone doing such a thing just to find their fated one.
Ordinary girls will certainly go for it.
Which means that she will also walk this grand path and seek her fated one?
Fated one... which means hoping to meet up with a good guy, I guess?
Which means...? A guy other than me...
Gnn...
Kitano Tenman-gu... What's that?
It's the temple of Sugawara no Michizane. It's in Kyoto, Kamigyou District, and Tenjin's flea market is taking place the 25th of each month.
But we won't be there at the right time, so we won't be able to see "Tenjin".
Did you memorize everything?
That's because I'm looking forward it. I've read the guidebook so many times.
Oh yes. Since Michizane is the god of wisdom, let's visit the shrine together.
Yeah.
I'm aiming for the same university as her.
There are two reasons for that.
First. Because I feel at ease when I'm with Manami, clear and simple.
The second is if I'm with Miss Ordinary Girl Manami, I will be able to walk on the path of the ordinary life, and that is my most precious desire.
When talking about ordinary, I feel like I've been at the total opposite of having an ordinary life lately. Seriously.
As expected from you, Manami, you're perfectly prepared for the school trip.
Fufufu... To prepare beforehand is also part of a trip's fun.
Hah... That's so like you...
Thanks to that, I'm looking forward to the school trip next week too.
Ehhhh?! Nothing?
Well, up till now I totally forgot about this school trip.
It won't come so suddenly...
Even though I looked forward to it so much, you're cruel...
Yeah yeah. Sorry.
Geez...
Ah, Kyou-chan. There's something I want to ask you...
Don't ask me anything about Kyoto.
It's not about that. Well... Do the guys sleep immediately upon lights out?
That's usually the case. Besides, are there any other things to do?
The girls will probably... talk about guys or something.
Hmm, isn't that fine?
T-They'll discuss on the guys they like! You're not interested?
Nope.
T-Then guys... don't talk about this?
They don't, I guess? In my case, I immediately go to bed.
I-I see...
We aren't elementary school kids; there's nothing to make a fuss about, right?
Geez, Kyou-chan sounds like an old man.
I don't want to hear that from you.
A common and ordinary school life.
The things I'm pursuing after are in there.
I'm not going overseas after all. It's just an very plain ordinary school trip. Both Manami and me are looking forward to it.
You ask 'why'?
Because if I were to go for the school trip, I could be freed from the dreadful life counseling.
Just leisurely enjoying school life from time to time, isn't all that bad.
